## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach taken. Link the relevant issue or
discussion when one exists.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any important scenarios that are not covered by
automated tests.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated formatting.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior at the layer that owns it.
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Schema changes include a generated migration and integration coverage.
- [ ] No credentials, private source, generated exploration artifacts, or personal data are included.
- [ ] I have read and will follow the Code of Conduct.
